macro and micro plastic residues affect soil physical and hydrological properties, but not chemical properties.
the presence of macro- and microplastic debris in soil can alter its physicochemical and hydraulic properties.

the impact of plastic mulch films debris on soil properties, which is a key issue of soil degradation and soil quality.
the impact of plastic debris on soil properties and its possible consequences for the soil ecosystem.
the impact of plastic debris in agroecological systems and the results provide a basis for further studies.

the impact of plastic residues on soil properties and soil functioning is complex, and depends on the plastic type and the plastic size.
the plastic mulch film residue in soil can affect soil properties and this may have an impact on soil functions and the ecosystem services that soils provide.

the plastic residues in soil are a serious environmental issue that needs to be addressed.
